title: A phone call
summary: A mother calls home and asks what everyone is doing.

sentences.en: Hello, son, what are you doing?
And your dad? Is he at home?

sentences.zh: 她在睡觉。妈妈，你在哪儿？
sentences.en: She's sleeping. Mum, where are you?
I'm at the office; I'm very busy now.

sentences.zh: 七点。吃饭的时候，不要看电视，好吗？
sentences.en: At seven. Don't watch TV while you eat, OK?

why: She's calling home, so she isn't there.

questions.prompt: What does Mum ask him not to do?
why: Right: 吃饭的时候，不要看电视.
Sleep isn't what she warns about.
